purpose: Teach: エンジェル/ルーマニア/ミレニアム/ギルド/ワイドショー/クリエイター/サイレント/ロフト

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがエンジェルの彫像を集められた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to collect angel statues.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice carries the weight of old memory. Gentle pace, like he's reaching back in time. Slight pause before 'angel' — a moment of affection for the detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ルーマニア体操の中継を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather watched the Romania gymnastics broadcast, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm interjection, gently correcting the thread. Light, knowing tone — she's redirecting with kindness. Slight lilt on the final 'dear,' like she's teasing him back into the present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがミレニアム記念の式典に参列された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he attended the Millennium commemoration ceremony.
lines.style: Same wistful quality as before. Steady, unhurried delivery. Slight deepening on the ceremonial weight of 'Millennium.' Trailing thought, like another memory surfacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、商店街のギルドにも入られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather joined the shopping street guild too, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Playful correction again. Warmer this time, with a note of pride in what her husband accomplished. 'Guild' lands with gentle emphasis. Affectionate and teasing in equal measure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが平日の昼のワイドショーを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he watched the daytime variety shows on weekdays.
lines.style: Same wistful rhythm established. Quieter on this one — more intimate memory. Gentle, almost conversational pace. The specificity of 'daytime' carries a small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、書道のクリエイターとして活動されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather practiced calligraphy as a creative pursuit, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright interjection, genuinely proud. Voice lifts slightly on 'calligraphy.' Warm and direct. The 'dear' is genuine affection, not correction this time — she's sharing in the memory with him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがサイレント映画祭に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to go to the silent film festivals.
lines.style: Deepest wistfulness yet. Slower, more reverent pace. This memory lands differently — more tender, almost fragile. Voice softens on 'silent film,' like he's watching the image in his mind.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、家のロフト部屋を書斎にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather made that loft room into a study, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Closing warmth. Voice close, intimate — like she's speaking just to him now. Soft landing on each detail. The 'dear' is pure affection. Gentle fade, a closing moment together.
